info.title: Munsha ERP — Consolidated API (Ordered by Feature)
info.description:
English-language unified OpenAPI design draft for Inventory, Accounting, Customers, Suppliers, Employees, Sales, Purchases, Expenses, Settings, Financial Statements, User Management & Permissions, Authentication, Sessions and Audit. Includes code-derived and proposed API contracts; not confirmation of backend implementation. Old unversioned financial-report paths remain unmodified pending API migration.

Version 1.4.0: prioritized business feature ordering; frontend route-difference triage; four additional proposed read contracts. Currencies and exchange rates belong only under Accounting. This document remains a design draft, not proof of implemented ASP.NET endpoints.

Version 1.5.0: frontend-derived report query and response alignment for four existing design endpoints. Auth permissions, heartbeat and legacy multiplexed command semantics remain explicitly unresolved; no invented backend compatibility.
